starter_questions: What will you check, and what do I need to provide?
Can you explain the report format without collecting logs?
How should I review coverage and uncertainty in the local report?

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording only; domain work and approvals keep their existing controls.

setup_guide.introduction: I'll prepare a bounded review of recent local Mac log metadata, with coverage and source receipts in a saved report. No input upload is needed; collection scope is automatic and the output folder is the only normal setting. Review private findings in the local report; Chat can explain the method and limits, and I cannot certify that your Mac is safe.

real.introduction: Keep the default report destination or choose another output folder. Logs are collected automatically on this Mac during a requested run; no source upload or elevated access is needed.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Folder for investigation reports. Recent Mac security logs are queried automatically.
